extracted.name: Gooey Double Chocolate Cookies
extracted.description: Rich, fudgy chocolate cookies with soft, gooey centers and melted chocolate chips in every bite. These taste like brownie-cookies with crackly tops and extra melty chocolate pockets—soft, thick, and super chocolatey
instruction_lines: Mix wet ingredients In a bowl, mix melted butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until smooth
Add egg + vanilla Stir in egg, honey, milk and vanilla until fully combined
Add dry ingredients Add flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix just until no dry flour remains.
Fold in chocolate chips Mix in chocolate chips (don’t overmix).
Chill dough (optional but better) Refrigerate dough for 10 minutes for thicker, gooey cookies.
Cool slightly Let sit on tray for 5 minutes so centers stay gooey.
